items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Another guy named Lee Pope, a very good saxophone player.

ctx.x: Harold Johnson was in that band, in Los Angeles. And Nat Towles had some great musicians. Another guy named Lee Pope, a very good saxophone player. Another excellent tenor saxophonist named Bob Dorsey. Man, he could play. He was a character, but he could play. And I'll tell you what happened. This has just come to me. There was a guy that always has been instrumental in helping musicians secure jobs, or get recordings for them, and he's always been a very good friend of mine, been very helpful to me. He was…
